text:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads-up — Snowflake reached out about doing a joint Delta Share + vector DB pilot (Qdrant) that shows seamless vector queries from Snow to our inference endpoints. Need alignment across eng, legal, marketplace, and Databricks compatibility. Can we sync early next week?
aj-gtm: :eyes: count me in. Can we define minimal success criteria up front? Thinking: end-to-end latency, sync window, and RBAC/ACL propagation.
sam-engineering: I did a small spike today — Delta Share will pass VARIANT payloads fine but we need a stable encoding for 512/1024-d vectors. Quick snippet I tested: ```curl -X POST https://qdrant-demo/ingest -d '{"id":1,"vector":"base64(...)","meta":{}}'``` will share via Delta. Need to map to Snow VARIANT + separate metadata columns.
rachel-product: For the marketplace listing we'll need screenshots, a short demo video, pricing suggestions, and a Databricks notebook demo. Also want a 30-day trial option for early partners.
denise-legal: I'll start a review of Snowflake's Delta Share terms and any data residency/KYC items. Can someone paste the partner contact and any SOC/ISO docs?
kevin-solutions: Partner contact is Li from Qdrant (li@qdrant.ai). They can spin up a PoC cluster and shared Delta endpoint for the pilot. I'll coordinate creds.
sam-engineering: Engineering ask: recommend storing vectors in Snowflake as VARIANT with base64 vector plus a separate FLOAT_ARRAY column if possible, or store as BLOB+metadata for faster export. Also need to verify Unity Catalog entitlement for Delta Sharing.
aj-gtm: Draft success criteria suggestion: 1) end-to-end query P50 < 150ms for 512-d vectors (inference excluded), 2) ACL propagation from Delta Share to our access checks works correctly, 3) sample notebook + marketplace listing published within three weeks, 4) partner-provided PoC env available.
maria-partnerships: I'll schedule a 45m sync Tue 10am PT with Snowflake, Qdrant, Databricks (if they want to join). Agenda: architecture, security/KMS, GTM checklist, and success metrics. @rachel-product please prepare marketplace checklist.
rachel-product: On it. Draft checklist items: listing assets, price tier recommendations, support SLA, integration docs, sample notebooks (Snow/Databricks), legal signoff, and a short how-to video. I’ll post the draft in #partnerships by EOD Mon.
ops-bot: Reminder: any pipeline touching customer data must follow the PII handling flow and be escalated. See policy: https://redwood.internal/policies/data-pii
denise-legal: Noted. Also confirm whether customers retain KMS control or partner-managed keys — I’ll need that for contract language.
sam-engineering: FYI: Databricks Unity Catalog sometimes requires extra entitlement for Delta Sharing. @aj can you check marketplace packaging to ensure customers won’t hit surprises?
aj-gtm: Good call. I’ll ping marketplace ops and confirm; if there’s a gap we’ll add an automation note in the docs.
kevin-solutions: I’ll collect Li's PoC details and drop creds in 1Password, marking them shared with the eng and prod teams.
maria-partnerships: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. If you can’t make Tue sync, drop updates here. I’ll circulate minutes and action items afterwards.
